display_long_description:
The Reality Academy application is your new virtual classroom.

Using Virtual Reality for training purposes increase by four the memorisation by immersing, both emotionally and physically, your learners into real scenarios.

Increase your colleagues’ skills thanks to management, company safety and mobility safety virtual training. Reality Academy has developed the largest virtual training program that you can find in a single app.

As the trainer you can choose to start rapidly the training thanks to the free mode or to track your learner’s results and performances thanks to the evaluation mode

Deploying VR has never been that simple ! We have developed a tutorial presented by TED, our dear robot, to allow your learner to develop good habits using VR material

Train, repeat and become an expert in facing company safety and company life issues.

Welcome to the Immersive Learning world !
